remarks: Located on highly desirable Guyer Road, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath plus bonus room home is being offered for the first time since 1980. Guyer Road is a quiet horseshoe street with limited traffic and a central Westport location offering convenient access to town, beaches, schools, and shopping. Originally part of an onion farm, the neighborhood was developed in the mid-to-late 1950s, and many homes have since been renovated, expanded, or rebuilt. This home is positioned in the valley section of the street on a .51-acre lot and offers a flexible floor plan with multiple living spaces, including a living room, dining room, and family room. One bedroom was created from the former garage and features its own exterior entrance, offering options for an office, guest area, or conversion back to garage space. The property offers an excellent opportunity for renovation, personalization, expansion or new build. Four bedrooms, two full baths, and a spacious lot provide a solid foundation for future improvements. A rare opportunity to purchase a home on Guyer Road, where properties do not often come on the market.
